olivia_success: Morning team — quick async standup re: AcmePay (renewal in ~3w). What I did: triaged support case #12345, pulled logs, escalated to eng. Blocker: embeddings drift causing rerank failures on 'contract search' (precision 0.82 -> 0.54 after last push). Today: preparing rollback plan, meeting w/ben at 11, prepping customer-facing note. Any quick asks for eng?

ben_eng: Can you paste a sample user query + top-5 results and confirm which model/version is in prod for them?

olivia_success: Sure — model reported by telemetry: redwood-model/text-embed-2:v2.3.1. Sample query + results below. Also short log snippet from their webhook.

```
Query: "find termination clause in supplier contract"
Results (ranked by embedding similarity):
1) doc_721: unrelated vendor onboarding checklist
2) doc_114: expense policy (incorrect)
3) doc_332: termination clause — correct but low score
4) doc_900: meeting notes
5) doc_221: sample contract appendix

Log snippet:
[2026-03-14T09:21:07Z] acct=acct-ACM-8892 embed_score=0.21 top_doc=doc_721
[2026-03-14T09:21:08Z] acct=acct-ACM-8892 model=redwood-model/text-embed-2:v2.3.1
```

maria_cs: Impact note: ~12% of searches in last 24h flagged as misranks by customer QA. They correlate spike to 2026-03-14 push. Renewal team is watching — customer asked for immediate mitigation.

ben_eng: Quick mitigation options: (1) per-customer routing rollback to v2.3.0, (2) temporary rerank post-filter using precomputed lexical signals. Prefer rollback if ops can do it quickly.

sam_ops: I can do a per-customer rollback. Need explicit customer_id and go-ahead. Expected window: ~30-60m to execute and validate across canary nodes. Also will watch latency/throughput. :clock1:

ryan_se: If we rollback, I want to run a small eval (10-20 queries) against v2.3.0 vs v2.3.1 and post precision/recall diffs. I can take that once rollback is live.

olivia_success: Customer_id: acct-ACM-8892. Customer approves rollback. @ben_eng @sam_ops please confirm and proceed. I'll update ticket #12345 and notify renewal lead.

ben_eng: Confirmed. Approve rollback to v2.3.0 for acct-ACM-8892. Ben will also add a quick patch to disable the embedding normalization tweak that landed in v2.3.1 (follow-up PR).

sam_ops: Proceeding with rollback for acct-ACM-8892 -> v2.3.0. Kicking off canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary rollback job 88421 for acct-ACM-8892: target model redwood-model/text-embed-2:v2.3.0. Canary 10% traffic. ETA ~7m. Logs streaming -> https://deploys.internal/88421 :rocket:

ryan_se: I'll run the eval once canary reaches 100% (or earlier on canary). Will post diff summary.

maria_cs: I'll send the rollback confirmation to the customer and ask them to validate the few failing queries. I'll keep renewal updated.

olivia_success: Thanks team. I'll update support ticket and schedule a renewal touchpoint next Tue. Please drop any post-rollback notes here. Really appreciate the quick run. :heart:
